summary: Digital Turbine filed a Form 8-K reporting the filing of a universal shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR and a Rule 424(b)(7) resale prospectus supplement covering 1,222,418 shares of common stock held by selling stockholders, issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants. The company filed only to provide a legal validity opinion (Exhibit 5.1) and related consent; no securities are being sold by the issuer and no proceeds are raised. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine warrant-related resale registration, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
